archetype: Archetype 5 (Luxury) - Premium, Depth, Mystery, mapped to Organic/Earthy warmth

headings.weight_strategy: Light (300) to Regular (400) for elegance, avoid bold weights to maintain editorial feel

styles.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tight leading-none text-white
styles.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-tight text-[#FFFCF8]

styles.base: text-base md:text-lg font-light leading-relaxed tracking-wide text-white

accents.usage: Use for chapter numbering, large background numerals, and fine detail accents

background.texture_instructions: CRITICAL: Do not use flat solid #3d211a. Apply a subtle noise/watercolor texture overlay to the background. You can use an SVG noise overlay (mix-blend-overlay, opacity 5-10%) or a CSS radial gradient to create warmth and depth.

accent.usage: Use sparingly for CTAs, underlines, icons, and key phrases.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Minimalist EDITORIAL / magazine-spread layout. Generous white (dark) space.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Use p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32. Sections must breathe deeply. Never cram content.
spacing_and_layout.grids: Bento/Tetris grids for the wedding gallery. Asymmetrical layouts with overlapping images (e.g., an image overlapping a text container slightly).
spacing_and_layout.hero: Full-bleed immersive high-quality photography. Use max overlay opacity bg-black/40 or a smooth gradient to let the image shine. Never use heavy black overlays.
spacing_and_layout.navigation: Sticky navigation, transparent over dark hero -> transitions to glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#3d211a]/80 border-b border-[#99824d]/20) on scroll.

buttons.primary: bg-transparent border border-[#99824d] text-[#FFFCF8] hover:bg-[#99824d] hover:text-white transition-all duration-500 font-poppins font-light px-10 py-4 rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest text-sm
buttons.secondary: text-[#f7d58f] underline decoration-[#99824d] decoration-1 underline-offset-8 hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 font-poppins uppercase tracking-widest text-xs

cards.services: bg-transparent border border-[#99824d]/20 p-8 md:p-12 hover:border-[#99824d]/60 transition-colors duration-500 rounded-none flex flex-col items-start group
cards.testimonials: Editorial layout, large italicized quotes in Cormorant Garamond (text-2xl to 4xl), client names in Poppins, subtle gold accent line separator.

sections: Hero: Full-bleed background image, large Cormorant Garamond heading ('Léomentia Event'), Calendly + Services CTA, sticky nav. Include brand SVG logo.
Intro/Philosophy: Large elegant text, Poiret One chapter number '01', asymmetrical image next to text.
Services Overview: 3 premium editorial cards or alternating left/right layout blocks showcasing wedding planner services.
Gallery Teaser (Galerie mariages): Masonry or Bento grid of recent elegant weddings. Mix landscape and portrait crops.
Testimonials (Témoignages clients): Single large quote slider or elegant stacked editorial layout.
Blog/Journal Teaser: 2-3 recent articles with delicate hover effects.
Footer: Minimalist, large logo, contact info, Calendly link.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do not use generic Shadcn cards for the main marketing pages; use custom HTML/Tailwind for the editorial asymmetrical feel.
CRITICAL: Apply the subtle noise texture over the #3d211a background.
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for headings, 'Poppins' for body, and 'Poiret One' for chapter numbers or accents.
Ensure the SVG logo is displayed and properly colored against the dark background.
Implement smooth scrolling (Lenis or similar) and subtle fade-up/reveal animations on scroll for the editorial feel.
Preserve existing forms and Calendly embeds, but restyle their containers to match the luxury dark theme.
